items.title: The Obral Ascent Major Update #3 | Available December 3rd
items.summary: Go beyond where any farseekers ever got and reach the peaks of Obral in our next Major Update to be released on December 3rd. The Obral Ascent Update introduce a brand new region with new dungeons, New Area - The Obral Summit The Obral Summ
items.content:
Go beyond where any farseekers ever got and reach the peaks of Obral in our next Major Update to be released on December 3rd. The Obral Ascent Update introduce a brand new region with new dungeons,

New Area - The Obral Summit

The Obral Summit is a mountainous region located north of Eksod. In it you’ll be able to use unique traversal option via sparkfused rails to move vertically across the terrain.

  • 6 New Dungeons

    [/*]

  • 80+ new activities

    [/*]

  • New Enemies - The thundering Swarowls, the ice-cold Bagons and the crystal-corrupted wildlife

    [/*]

  • Unique Traversal Options

    [/*]

Get your character to a new level

With this update, your character will be able to gain 10 more levels from where it is now. With those levels, you’ll be able to equip new gears, advance in your professions, and get new weapons imbued with ice and lightning.

You will also get a new talent tree to shape your fighting style in a brand new direction!

Go up to level 35

  • New Talent tree for each class

    [/*]

  • New gears & weapons

    [/*]

  • New collectibles

    [/*]

Coming in January - The Herald Order

At the peak of Obral is the Monastery held by the Seekers of Luon. Who are they and what do they want with you? You’ll figure this all out with complementary updates planned for January

  • New Dungeon - Ul’Serous Monastery

    [/*]

  • New Reputation - The Seekers of Luon

    [/*]

  • New challenge - The Trials

    [/*]

Public Test Available (5pm UTC)

This update will be available in our dedicated Public Test Branch!

Feel free to jump in and put your strength to the test. We have opened specific feedback forums on Discord and Steam, as well as a megathread on Reddit.

We have also added some other features that you might want to try. You can find the complete list below.

\

To access the Preview:

  • Right-click on Farever in your Steam Library

    [/*]

  • Select Properties → Betas

    [/*]

  • Choose the “Public Beta Branch”

    [/*]

You can stream the content of the public Test Branch so feel free to share it on your channel!

Avoid sharing it in official forums outside dedicated sections to not spoil those wanting to discover it at launch!

Thank you for playing our game, giving us your feedback, whether you follow along in the public test or wait for the official release. This update bring a lot of new things and we’re looking forward to your experience in it!

See you at the peak Farseekers ✨

The Farever Team.

items.title: Farever Shop Info and Update
items.summary: Hey Farseekers! As we continue supporting the growth of Farever with new content, features, and ongoing performance improvements, we are getting ready to test the opening of the Farever shop, where you will find purchasable cosmetic items,
items.content:
Hey Farseekers! As we continue supporting the growth of Farever with new content, features, and ongoing performance improvements, we are getting ready to test the opening of the Farever shop, where you will find purchasable cosmetic items, helping us further support the development of the game. The Farever shop is now available on the Public Test Branch, with a first set of items. Purchases made on the Public Test Branch will make the items available in your collections on all live servers you’re playing on.

How the Shop Works

To access the shop, you can go to the menu by pressing “escape” and checking the “Shop” option. Here you will have different tabs for the different sets. Here you will find unique mounts, pets, gliders, and, in the future, more cool-looking cosmetics. These items are optional and do not have any gameplay impact or give any advantage to players who purchase them (except looking great). Once purchased, these items directly join your Collection tab. They are accessible for all of your characters across regions and cannot be traded away. Shop items can be purchased using Spark Coins, a separate currency available in packs directly in the same Shop. We are currently testing this feature in the Public Test Branch. You can already test it yourself, as all purchases done in the PTR will be available directly to you in the live version as well! To join the Public Test Branch:
  • Right-click on Farever in your Steam Library
  • Select Properties → Betas
  • Choose the “Public Beta Branch”
 The Farever Shop will grow alongside the game, helping support ongoing development and server maintenance, without taking priority over new updates, quality-of-life features, or performance improvements.

New set in the shop - Lizhazard Bundle

In the shop, you can currently find the Lizhazard Bundle. It contains all the elements you can expect in future sets for the shop. A glider, a pet, and a mount. Here they are:
  • Lizhazard Kodog - Kodogs are a clever cross between a large lizard and a dog. They are incredibly affectionate but can change their mood in a matter of seconds. When they shed, they leave enough skin and fur behind to accidentally duplicate themselves.
  • Lizhazard Saladmander - The dorsal fur of Lizhazard Saladmanders blooms in the fall and sometimes bursts into flames during mating displays. Some careless males have even ended up charred to a crisp on nights of passionate love.
  • Lizhazard Thunderhawk - Contrary to what their name might suggest, Thunderhawks have nothing in common with either thunder or hawks. They can glide but not fly, and they are terrified of bad weather. Biologists are sometimes seized by a creative frenzy when it comes to naming creatures.
The previous Early Access Bundle is still available for free in the shop, and will remain until the end of early access! New cosmetic items will be updated in the shop alongside updates to the game in the future. We want to thank you for supporting us during this Early Access period. We also want to remind you that you can also support the game simply by being a part of the community, leaving in-game feedback to help us improve your experience and by leaving a review on Steam! - Farever Teamhttps://store.steampowered.com/app/3672400/Farever/

items.summary: v0.3.30903 Performance Following yesterday updates, a large number of stutters has been reported. We've found the main source of the issue (shader compilations) and have fixed what caused the issue. The improvements done yesterdays still ap
items.content:
v0.3.30903

Performance

Following yesterday updates, a large number of stutters has been reported. We've found the main source of the issue (shader compilations) and have fixed what caused the issue. The improvements done yesterdays still applies and can now be enjoyed by all! What has been added today
  • Improved shader cache access (reduce stutter at launch and in instances)
What was done yesterday
  • Improved Performance overall
    • Added DLSS 3
    • Greatly reduced CPU load
  • Reduced Stuttering
    • Added Triple Buffering
    • Improved Shader Compilation
Optimisation is an ongoing process, we'll make sure to continue working on that front alongside future updates! If that's your first time launching the game since the update, you may still expect some stutter, but those will be less severe and will pass after a few minutes.

BugFix

  • Fixed moving a depleted (0-charge) item no longer duplicates it. To delete duplicated items, overlap a charged item on it.
  • Fixed localisation not working for some new NPC
  • Fixed unable to leave the chat with the controller
  • Fixed Heal working on player waiting to be revived
  • Improved skill icons’ compression to avoid stutters when adding statuses
  • Fixed duplication of empty charges items in inventory
  • Fixed input being stuck on controller when backing out from chat
  • Fixed skills from summon cancelling your dash’s sprint

Weapons

Flame of Argol
  • Fixed Rank 3 of “Heat Emission” description and being active at Rank 1

Instance

Ratsar
  • Fixed Ratsar Lighter animation during Mad Run skill
  • Fix visual artifacts in Mine Estrone
Reblochonk
  • No longer throws a cheese immediately at the start of combat.

Heroic Difficulty

  • Bosses’ Health has been adjusted when playing at 3 and 4 players
  • The First Heroic Dungeon you will complete will grant you 100 Medals of Glory, allowing the immediate purchase of a chest to the merchant. For players who already have completed Heroic Dungeons, the next you’ll complete will grant you 100 Medals of Glory.
  • Fixed medal of glory visuals
Nepsilon (Heroic)
  • Fixed a bug allowing the boss to sometimes cast 2 Water Volleys in-a-row
  • A telegraph has been added to anticipate better the Water Volley cast
  • Water Volley’s casting time has been increased
  • No longer summons a totem immediately at the start of combat.
Crabgantua (Heroic)
  • The boss casts bubbles less often
  • Fixed a bug making split bubbles faster than unsplit bubbles
  • A telegraph has been added to anticipate better the Bubble cast
  • Fixed rock falling on geyser spot
Ratsar (Heroic)
  • The visuals of Ratsar spinning through Brazier has been updated so that we no longer think that putting out one fire just creates another
